profile_text.body:
Dell Technologies is a public company founded in 1984 and headquartered in Round Rock, Texas, United States. It trades under the ticker DELL. On its own site, Dell describes itself as providing technology solutions, services and support, and lists laptops, touch screen PCs, desktops, servers, storage, monitors, gaming products and accessories among what it sells. The site also promotes Copilot+ PCs, describing them as combining performance, built-in intelligence and all-day battery life, and highlights the XPS 13 and Dell 14 Plus. Dell Premier is presented as a way for organizations to buy, manage and support their IT.

The site text also carries retail terms, including a 30-day return period calculated from invoice date and expedited delivery that is not available on certain TVs, monitors, batteries and adapters and is limited to the continental U.S. except Alaska.

Among the facts on record, Dell has 126 cases in Texas. No products, lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for the company in the data provided.
